About This Tool

Accidentally typed a paragraph with Caps Lock on, or need to convert headlines into AP-style Title Case or programming code into camelCase or snake_case? Our free Case Converter transforms text instantly with one click and lets you copy or download the result immediately.

Frequently Asked Questions

Title Case capitalizes the first letter of each major word in a sentence, which is the standard formatting for article headlines, book titles, and essay headings.
